headline: Approved changes to grant guidelines and priorities, plus $500 for pens, stickers and a tablecloth.
summary: A grant report was accepted, and the 7/23/26 minutes were approved. Survey results showed 113 surveys collected, split evenly between online and paper. Two Reveille ads were approved: a $40 recruitment ad and a $20 grant cycle ad.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the 7/23/26 meeting, 8-0 with one abstention.
Approved the changes to grant guidelines and priorities, and the in-person grant training date, and authorized Eva and Dan to set that date, 7-0 with one abstention.
Approved placing Ricardo's recruitment ad in the Reveille, with added graphics by Shara, and budgeting $40, 7-0.
Approved spending $500 of the $1000 budget on pens, stickers, a tablecloth, and decaling, 7-0.
Approved spending $20 on a half-page Reveille ad advertising the grant cycle, 7-0.

plain_text:
FITCHBURG CULTURAL COUNCIL MINUTES 
THURSDAY, AUGUST 27, 2026  
LEGISLATIVE BUILDING 
700 MAIN STREET 
  
 
In attendance: Eva Kelly (chair), Shara Osgood (secretary), Dan Dow (grant coordinator)(via 
zoom), Mike Amadeo, Ricardo Barros, Sarahbeth Wheeler (via zoom), Julio Fuentes, Kat 
McLellan, Tamar Russell-Brown (ex-officio)(via zoom) 
 
(view recording for details of meeting at fatv.org) 
 
CALL TO ORDER: Eva called the meeting to order at 5:07 p.m 
 
INTRODUCTORY COMMENTS: 
Eva spoke: Welcome, MCC Mission, Public Meeting guidelines & protocols 
 
PUBLIC COMMENTS: 
 No Attendees. No comments.   
 
GRANTEE PRESENTATION: 
Shara Osgood presented about Lowe Park Chalk Art Festival 
 
NEW MEMBER APPLICATIONS:  
No new members. Rolling appointments & terms.  For info, inquire at: 
fitchburg.mcc@gmail.com   
 
VOTE: GRANT REPORT: 
Cycle FY26: of the total 54 grants, all have sent agreement, 13 have submitted final reports. 
Cycle FY25: 72 grantees have submitted final reports. 4 are still owe final grant reports.  
Contacted grantees with outstanding reports, letting them know that they will be ineligible for 
grants in the next cycle. 
As we move towards the FY27 cycle, much of Dan’s focus will be on the new cycle & making 
sure that those interested, have the tools & knowledge to succeed. 
Motion; Ricardo to accept grant report 
2nd: Julio 
In Favor: 8  Opposed:0 
Motion Passes Unanimously
VOTE: TREASURERS REPORT 
Liz is out sick. No report this month. 
 
VOTE: MINUTES  
Monthly Meeting Review minutes from 07-23-26  
 
Motion: Sarahbeth To accept Meeting Minutes from 7/23/26 
2nd: Ricardo 
In Favor: 8 Opposed:0 Abstained:x 
Motion Passes Unanimously 
 
DISCUSSION ITEMS: 
Survey Results: 113 total surveys collected. 50/50 split between online& on paper. 
See results on fatv recording.   
 
Guidelines & Priorities - see recording for details. 
Motion:  Ricardo,  To accept the guidelines and priorities changes we discussed, & accept grant 
training date for in person training, and authorize  Eva & Dan to set that date 
2nd: Mike 
In Favor: 7, Opposed:0 Abstained:x (Sarahbeth left) 
Motion Passes Unanimously 
 
Reveille Recruitment Advertisement -  
Motion: Shara to put Ricardo’s ad in the Reveille, with added graphic dynamism made by Shara 
& $40 to be budgeted 
Second: Dan 
In Favor: 7  Opposed: 0 
Passes Unanimously 
 
Communications Subcommittee: 
Met to discuss spending funds for swag.  
Motion: Dan to spend $500 of the $1000 budget to purchase pens, stickers, tablecloth & get it 
decalled 
Second: Mike 
In Favor: 7 Opposed: 0 
 
Grant Cycle Advertisement 
Motion: Dan to spend $20 for a 1/2 page ad (that Ricardo made), in the Reveille advertising our 
grant cycle. 
Second: Kat
In Favor: 7 Opposed:0 
Passes Unanimously  
 
UPCOMING EVENTS ANNOUNCEMENTS; 
Thursday, September 10, 2026 @ 6pm: Applicant Info Session 
This is a free session for LCC program applicants. We will walk potential applicants through the 
application process.  Recommended for LCC members and grant applicants. 
Fitchburg Open Studios - October 17 & 18, 12-5pm 
Thursday, October 15, 2026 @ 11:59pm: Application Submission Closes 
Other upcoming events: 
August 28 5pm at City Hall - Openest Mic with the Poet Kaureate of Worcester County 
Lowe Park Chalk Art Festival is on 9/12/26 11am-4pm at Lowe. Park on Elm Street. 
 
ADJOURN: 
Motion: Kat -  To adjourn 
2nd: Shara 
No vote required  
Adjourn @ 6:12pm 
 
Submitted by Shara Osgood
